points.description: States cetyl alcohol (hexadecanol) as an evaporation inhibitor, using the correct chemical name (cetyl alcohol or hexadecanol).
States stearyl alcohol (octadecanol) as an evaporation inhibitor, using the correct chemical name (stearyl alcohol or octadecanol).

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) only if both cetyl alcohol (hexadecanol) and stearyl alcohol (octadecanol) are named correctly. Each chemical earns 1 mark; the generic "fatty alcohols", "alcohol", "wax" or "monolayer" earns nothing. A wrong extra chemical (e.g. ethanol, oil, or any other substance) cancels the mark for the point it affects, so the student should lose 1 mark per wrong item, not below 0. The alternative names hexadecanol and octadecanol are accepted.
